title: The Learn provider requests a Learn page at its locale form, so detect follows no locale redirect
goal: provider.raw_url gives a learn.microsoft.com url that has no locale segment its /en-us/ form, so detect makes one request for each of the 689 live Learn sources that answered a locale-only redirect at their last run; a url with a locale keeps it

clauses.clause: provider.raw_url gives a learn.microsoft.com url that has no locale segment its /en-us/ form, so detect makes one request for each of the 689 live Learn sources that answered a locale-only redirect at their last run
a url with a locale keeps it

notes: Blocks: operator request 2026-10-20, the whole census tooling epic EP-mkzkd7in before the census of EP-aolytxc5 (ST-zpe7qxtv depends on this item), so a sprint may take this parked draft. 2026-10-20 planning: of 728 live Learn sources whose _fetch_state.csv final_url differs from the url, 689 differ only by /en-us/ and 39 moved to another page; the census reads those 39 as moved in phase 2, so this item re-sources no source row and its touches leave kb/public. Premise: the check fails, raw_url keeps https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/ai/mcp/odr-tool without a locale. Research ST-77p3ppiz 2026-10-21 (kb public/agents/doc-change-detection.md:80-82): a locale-less Learn URL answers 302 to /en-us/<path>; ?accept=text/markdown and Accept: text/markdown both survive the redirect and return 200 text/markdown; a locale in the path is kept; GET, not HEAD, for the markdown check (a HEAD for pl-pl returned text/html).
